name: Penumbra Prism Haven
core_rationale: Central twilight-observatory sanctuary of Penumbra Prism Reef at [1, 1] where dream-glass cartographers chart the dual shadows above the Twilight Coral Crypt.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Half-lit silver and violet reflection pools ringed by floating coral lanterns

North.lock_message: Blinding corona-glare across Corona-Flare Arch disorients unshielded gliders; Prism-Navigator Lyra requires the Penumbral Filter Lens before opening the northern arch.

resident_npcs.name: Prism-Navigator Lyra
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Penumbra Prism Haven! Step up to my 0.58 meter twilight chart table and see how our reef casts one shadow upward and one downward.

resident_npcs.name: Coral-Grinder Solen
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Twilight Coral Crypt, a prism-coral leviathan guards the Penumbral Filter Lens needed to cross Corona-Flare Arch!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Penumbra Prism Reef at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's Twilight Coral Crypt and connects west to Penumbra Refraction Causeway.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt-and-coral observatory plaza glowing with dual silver and violet twilight reflections.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m chart tables, 0.14m basalt risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Corona-Flare Arch behind a Fog of Lore portal requiring the Penumbral Filter Lens.
